notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/cd1428505181a7cc457c5925e9b4e2d3b6767a41.jpg"][/img]Hello, Players![/p][p]Today's maintenance ended.[/p][p]We thank players for their cooperation.[/p][p]Please check the contents of the update![b]  

■ Bug Information[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Issue where certain JWL price options cannot be selected[/b]
　When the initial selection is set to "Diamond," the "50 JWL" option cannot be selected.
　Currently, if you purchase an item with a different JWL option (e.g., Unlimited or 650 JWL), and the default setting switches to JWL, you will then be able to purchase items with 50 JWL.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Translation issue[/b]
　Some items and UI elements are not displaying the correct translations.
[/p][/*][*][p]Even when Diamonds are selected in areas such as My Home or Circle, JWL is being prioritized and used instead.[/p][/*][/olist][p]We are currently working on fixing the above issues.
Once the fixes are completed, we will make a new announcement to inform you.[b]

■ Maintenance Details 1.Addition of New Items[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/9c572ac12ed63ddb791fffed45f40cd81f784430.jpg"][/img]⇒ Over 100 new costume items have been added to the Item Shop. [b] 

2. Limited-Time Packages on Sale[/b][/p][p]Best Friend Slot Expansion Card Pack (800 JWL)[/p][p]⇒ Best Friend Slot Expansion Card (x1): Using this item increases your best friend slot by 1.

[b]3. R2BEAT 20th Anniversary Event[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Login Event[/b]
Receive valuable rewards upon login (some rewards require purchase).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/3bb38dc98c83efe9356c2fe0ba1a2c8e5616bbe7.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Anniversary Passport[/b]
Complete missions to increase your event level and earn exclusive outfits.
※ Each level will increase once you accumulate [b]440 points[/b].
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/54625f438764f60fa8e7090f513084f705583351.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Diamond Currency System[/b]
A new currency, Diamonds, which can be purchased with JEWEL, has been implemented.
There are special bonuses for the first purchase, but in principle, JEWEL and Diamonds hold the same value.
[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]4.  Sever maintenanace and check up[/b][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and understanding.[/p][p][b]『R2BEAT』Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch Note | 2025/07/23　[Updated 2025/07/31]
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/620c62aa07d4cae284b6c29d9661cfbade0d1d54.jpg"][/img]Hello, Players![/p][p]Today's maintenance ended.[/p][p]We thank players for their cooperation.[/p][p]Please check the contents of the update![/p][p]
■Notice \[Updated 2025/07/31][/p][p]We are excited to reveal the [b]Custom Avatar Design[/b] from the “Coordicon Season 1” (Costume Contest)!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/4b4810bd917baf3908dc3a77a58fff2a10dd3d9a.jpg"][/img]By winning 1st place in the Coordicon event, players receive the item "Private Custom Wear.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/78a6cb5fd67a68fb3b9255dc665966aba4de8ee6.png"][/img]
This item serves as proof of being the top winner in the fashion contest.[/p][p]If you have earned this item, please submit the design or concept of the costume you would like us to create via the official support form.[/p][p]A special custom avatar outfit will be produced based on your request.[/p][p]Once completed, your Custom Avatar will be delivered to you.[/p][p]Please note that production may take approximately three months.[/p][p]The completed outfit may also be made available for purchase in the in-game shop after implementation.

■ Maintenance Details[/p][p]1.Implementation of New Feature: Sonic Stone[/p][p]The Sonic Stone is a special item that can be equipped on Wings and Pets.[/p][p]Items that support Sonic Stone will display an equip UI.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/23f02dbb2982758fe47f9a5f24a50c8e7a74b573.png"][/img][/p][p]By equipping a Sonic Stone, you can receive effects such as EXP bonuses and Gold Coin bonuses.[/p][p]※ If equipped on time-limited pets, the Sonic Stone will disappear together with the pet when the duration ends.[/p][p]※ Sonic Stones can be purchased from the shop.
[/p][p]2.Addition of New Items[/p][p]⇒ Over 300 new costume items have been added to the Item Shop.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/b3dc27d2920656630c59340db7a3400a989d09ac.png"][/img][/p][p]3.Limited-Time Package Sale[/p][p]⇒ Includes 5 item types: Hair, Wear, Pants (Skirt), Skates, Accessories[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/5f8187c48f75b2d07e71caea7e648e031945eedf.png"][/img]
● “Zero Romance” Series (2,800 JWL)
[/p][p]4.Coordicon Season 2 Launch \[Updated 2025/07/31][/p][p]■ Event Period: From Thursday, July 24, 2025 to Wednesday, September 24, 2025 (planned)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/ae433600336bb786f22313c2382e36b2caf1bf8c.png"][/img][b]\[1] Event Preparation & Feature Overview[/b]
 1) Use the photo feature in “My Home” to participate in the event.
 ＊ Enter “My Home” from your profile on the Home Screen.
 ＊ Photo Shooting: Take photos of your character. These can be viewed under the “Works” menu. (They are not submitted yet.)
 ＊ Focal Distance: Zoom in on the character.
 ＊ Camera Rotation: Slightly rotate the screen.
 ＊ Aperture Adjustment: Slightly blur the background.
 ＊ Action: Pause on general or couple actions to set your favorite pose.
 ＊ Camera Preset: Save frequently used camera settings and actions.
 ＊ Hide UI: Remove on-screen UI for screenshots. Click to toggle back.
 ＊ Works: Check your captured shots.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]\[2] Join the Contest![/b]
 ＊ If your photo taken in “My Home” receives [b]60 points or more[/b] in “Nari’s Evaluation,” you can enter the costume contest.
 ＊ You can delete or modify your submitted work [b]after 24 hours[/b].
 ＊ “Nari’s Evaluation” starts at 10 points, with additional points added for each equipped clothing part. You can check your score on the contest entry page.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]\[3] Vote for Your Favorite Costume![/b]
 ＊ Complete weekly missions to receive [b]Voting Tickets[/b].
 ＊ Use these tickets to vote for other players' submitted entries.
 ＊ Voting earns you [b]Exchange Coins[/b], which can be traded for various items at the Exchange Shop.
 ＊ Player votes determine the rankings—aim for the top to earn great rewards![/p][hr][/hr][p]■Regarding Development Data Appearing in the Event Ranking
We have confirmed an issue where development data entries “aoi” and “wawa” are appearing in the rankings of the ongoing “Coordicon Season 2” event.
This data will be removed in the next update.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the confusion caused by this issue.

5. Sever maintenanace and check up

6. Regarding the Probability Distribution of the "Lucky Ticket \[Random Reward]"[/p][p]We would like to inform you of the probability distribution for the "Lucky Ticket \[Random Reward]" which can be exchanged in-game in "R2BEAT."[/p][p]※ For some items such as costumes, the probabilities are listed as a combined total.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/eaa906e27b66a7ae6580acc6102a9958691a4ca0.jpg[/img]

Hello, Players!

Today's maintenance ended at 1:00(PDT).
We thank players for their cooperation.

Please check the contents of the update!


[b]■Updated Contents[/b]
　[b]1. Add New Items[/b]
　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/209d7773aee8eddba07dc5160385764851761250.png[/img]

　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/9b1b1003ca8a66c40ba98b916cce9b9156ee0638.png[/img]
　　⇒ Over 80 new costume items have been added to the Item Store。


　[b]2. Limited Time package Sales[/b]

　　●　[u]Brilliantly Luminous pack (3,000 JWL)[/u]

　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/c8a158c478add60cbc08eae7e2a219f45fe2e460.png[/img]
　　⇒　5 pieces : hair, top, bottom(skirt), skate, accessories

　　●　[u]Clarifying mirror water pack (3,000 JWL)[/u]

　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/0fe3731da5a103557c0e2fe092900bdd02e5dabf.png[/img]
　　⇒　5 pieces : hair, top, bottom(skirt), skate, accessories


　[b]3. Add of costume layering function[/b]
　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/92fcd3ecd128756e130d6e1456487a9d316e8968.png[/img]
　　The ability to layer costumes has been implemented from [Home] ⇒ [Items].

　　・「[u]Effect Change[/u]」button to set the effect of the selected item.
　　・「[u]Costume Change[/u]」 button, you can change the appearance of the selected item.

　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/e5ffa0dae393b3a69ea59aec813a78c8f5ef2e75.png[/img]
　　It will also be possible to change the SET and save it with a different item.

　　"?" button will display a popup about the layering function.


　[b]4. Add of shadow mode[/b]

　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/29e69203b56620c6dfc5f99e7f3a5578c0e8bcc6.png[/img]
　　⇒ In [Practice Mode], click the "Shadow Mode" icon to start Shadow Challenge Mode.
　　⇒ In this mode, you can battle against the shadow (ghost data) of the top scorer for the selected song.


　　■ Unlock Conditions for the Mode
　　One of the following conditions must be met:

　　・Be a VIP user
　　・Use a "BOT key" item when playing


　[b]5. Sever maintenanace and check up[/b]



Thank you for your patience and understanding.

『R2BEAT』Team

notes.title: Patch Note | 05/15/2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/1535ee760930e00911007efb199db89c1cb4d3f6.jpg[/img]

Hello, Players!

Today's maintenance ended at 3:00(PDT).
We thank players for their cooperation.

Please check the contents of the update!


[b]■Updated Contents[/b]
　[b]1. Added New Music[/b]
 　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/110f977afa262e15f08f1eac2ce0681e81a9b1f2.png[/img]
　　⇒ We have updated 14 songs, including each difficulty level.


　[b]2.  Added New Items[/b]
　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/dd8fe660f3daf2d1c659898342a8a7c407186aff.png[/img]
　　⇒ 81 new costume items have been added to the Item Store.

　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/a1255145ad607d8938334900ddcf6b121c75c80b.png[/img]
　　⇒ 38 new costume items have been added to the VIP Store.

　　⇒ 32 new furniture items have been added to the My home Store.


　[b]3. New season of “R2 Pass” begins[/b]
　　A new season of the “R2 Pass” will begin on May 15, 2025 and run through July 23, 2025(PDT)!
　　Try to complete pass missions to raise your R2 pass level and get various reward items!

　[b][1] Level Rewards[/b]
　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/946f914c9a76367cc9a4cd167717017849a0aeb5.png[/img]
　　⇒ Pass experience by completing missions and earn rewards according to your level.
　　⇒ The Special Pass can be activated for 1500 JWL. After activation, you can get two additional items per level.
　　⇒ If you activate the Special Pass after achieving a certain level, you will also receive all previous rewards.
　　⇒ You can obtain reward items by clicking the "Bulk Receive" button.
　　⇒ Click on “Preview” to see the set of avatars you can acquire from the R2 pass.

　[b][2] Buy Level[/b]
　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/2bc30585424f9f92f48b9f123ee2a585104ab753.png[/img]
　　⇒ You can wear out your JWL and increase the level of your R2 pass.
　　⇒ The “+” button allows you to select the level you want to raise and purchase the level you want to raise.
　　⇒ In the “Level Purchase” section, you can purchase up to level 40.

　[b][3] Ranking[/b]
　　⇒ After the season opens, the order will be ranked according to the order in which the 50 pass levels are achieved the fastest.
　　⇒ Pass level ranking rewards can be found by clicking on the [Rewards] button.
　　⇒ Rankings are updated every minute.

　[b][4] Missions[/b]
　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/de039d6bda8493cdc879970c7a485a5ec60e8735.png[/img]
　　⇒ Earn pass experience and pass coins by completing missions.
　　⇒ Pass coins earned by completing missions can be exchanged for a variety of items.
　　⇒ Pass level 40 and above can be raised only by missions clear.

　[b][5] Season Exchange[/b]
　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/f9acada82e470e273b6478c1f6d8b42a82e684c1.png[/img]
　　⇒ Items can be exchanged with pass coins earned by clearing missions.


　[b]4. New season of "Ranked Play" begins[/b]
　　The “Ranking Competition” S3 season will be held from May 15, 2025 to July 23, 2025(PDT)!
　　Clicking the “Ranked Play” icon on the menu side will bring up the lobby screen for ranking competitions.

　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/0882f95a068a25c605cada2d44f803f91b26e24e.png[/img]
　　[b][1] About ”Ranked Play”[/b]
　　　⇒ There are a total of nine tier grades.
　　　　　Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master, Grand Master, Challenger
　　　⇒ In Single Mode, four players of the same tier play together.
　　　⇒ All playmaps and musics are set at random.
　　　⇒ When matching, the player will be matched with a regular player within a maximum of 40 seconds, and if the time exceeds 40 seconds, the player will be matched with an AI player.
　　　　　Notes : In the “Challenger” tier, you will not be matched with AI players.
　　　⇒ Rewards will be distributed via email each time a tier is raised.
　　　⇒ Once the season ends, rewards will be distributed via email approximately one hour later.

　　[b][2] Opening time for Ranked play[/b]
　　　⇒ Weekdays: 20:00 - 22:00, 3:00 - 8:00(PDT) 2 openings
　　　⇒ Weekends: Open 24 hours



[b]5. "R2BEAT✕S4 League" Login Check Event begins[/b]
　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/56a7462f391cfe2d7d28c61ecf92a44441de02b0.png[/img]
　　R2BEAT✕S4 League" collaboration celebration!
　　Log in to the game for 7 days to get reward items!

　⇒　Event Period： After May 15 maintenance ~ Before July 23 maintenance(PDT)



[b]6. New content “Hard Mode” update[/b]
　⇒ When creating a game room, you can activate it by checking “HARD” in the upper right side of the window.
　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/e66696c2663290b8ae2466cb695eeda1dec0149e.png[/img]
　　　Notes：“4Key“ and ”HARD" mode cannot be checked at the same time.

　⇒ About ”Hard Mode”
　　-	This is a mode in which judgments of 90% or more are checked more strictly.
　　-	Only judgments up to 70% are allowed; all judgments below that level are “failures”.
　　-	This mode is for multiplayer only and is not available in practice mode.
　　-	“Hard mode” does not affect the rewards.
　　-	If the game room you create is in “Hard Mode”, all players who join the game room will also play in “Hard Mode”.
　　-	Please check the “HARD” checkbox on the lower right side when searching for game rooms.


　⇒ In “HARD” mode, special effects are displayed in the room list frame.
　　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/6df4935578d06313beec56ee8df78afe31a2fdd7.png[/img]

　⇒ When creating a game room in “HARD” mode, the Music list is displayed with a red flame theme.
　　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/a6c057b1d8a802d717bd4273d7177e2d9dc58815.png[/img]


[b]7. Fixed the bugs[/b]
　　-　Fixed problem where items could not be purchased in the "BF Shop"
　　-　Fixed problem where items could not be purchased in the "Wedding Shop"
　　-　Fixed a time-over issue when game matching
　　-　Fixed problem some face items not being available for purchase


[b]9. Server maintenance and checkup[/b]
　　-　error with “R2PASS” UI being displayed in Spanish from the English version of client.
　　-　error with the display of a message related to the 'Ranked Play' when getting rewards for the ‘R2BEAT✕S4 League’ login check event.


[b]9. Server maintenance and checkup[/b]


Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Server maintenance for Bug Fixes | 04/03/2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/97a35793b66661c86c6f426cba82b36eeef4a432.jpg[/img]


Hello, Players!

We will be performing server maintenance on April 3, 2025, to fix bugs.
For more details, please check the information below.


[b]● Date[/b]
April 3, 2025, approximately between 0:00 and 1:00 (PDT)
※ This is a minor maintenance and will not affect gameplay.


[b]● Details[/b]
　1. Resolves an issue preventing item purchases in the "My Home" store.

　2. Resolves an issue causing the "Friends" list in Messenger to appear blank.

　3. Resolves an issue causing the game client to crash when moving to "R2 Farm."
　　※　After the March 27, 2025 update, the logging system failed to start properly and will be replaced. 
　　　　As a result, all players' log records will be deleted. 
　　※　Note that this will not affect your possessed items or farm progress.

　4. Resolves an issue preventing the purchase of logo items in the "Circle."
　
　5. Resolves an issue with the login check event during the return event and the inability to purchase special packages.



We are currently working to resolve identified issues and are striving to address them promptly.

Certain errors may be specific to individual player characters, so we kindly ask that you provide the character name along with a screenshot.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience experienced by all players.
Thank you for your continued support of R2BEAT.

notes.title: Patch Note | 03/27/2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/1535ee760930e00911007efb199db89c1cb4d3f6.jpg[/img]


Hello, Players!

With today's update, you can now play 『R2BEAT』 on VFUN,
『R2BEAT』  can now also be played in English and Spanish!

Please check the contents of the update and enjoy your 『R2BEAT』 life!


[u]　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　[/u]


[h3]■Updated Contents[/h3]

[b]１.　Global Updates and VFUN Channeling Open[/b]
　　⇒ Can be played in English and Spanish, Global version has been updated!
　　　　 welcome to 『R2BEAT』、new players!
　　⇒ Inquiries at VFUN and Steam will be made mainly in English and Japanese.
　　⇒　Spanish versions of various notifications may be a little later than Japanese and English. We appreciate your understanding.
　　⇒ We have prepared various events to celebrate the update of the global version.

　　[b]①　14-day login check event[/b]
　　　　⇒ Event period: After maintenance on March 27th to before maintenance on April 9th (PDT)
　　　　⇒ To celebrate the update of the global version of the game, we have prepared a login check event in which players can earn various items by logging into the game for 14 days.


　　[b]②　Keyword event[/b]
　　　　⇒ One keyword will be distributed every two days from after maintenance on March 27th 
　　　　　 until 7:59 on April 9th (PDT).
　　　　⇒ please go to any other place in the game where you can enter chat, except the lobby, 
　　　　　and enter the keyword.
　　　　⇒ The keywords will be published on the official Discord and official X and VFUN lounge!
　　　　　　└　[url=https://discord.com/invite/YR35kFcfee]Official Discord[/url]
　　　　　　└　[url=https://x.com/Pmang_Music]Official X[/url]
　　　　　　└　[url=https://vfun-lounge.valofe.com/page/r2beat-gl/Event]VFUN Lounge[/url]

　　[b]③　Boost Event[/b]
　　　　　⇒ Event period: From March 31st 8:00 to April 9th 7:59(PDT)
　　　　　⇒ Application of double the amount of experience gain and double the amount of Rcoin gain



[b]2.　Added New Music[/b]
　　-　We have updated 26 songs, including each difficulty level.
　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/7f7bf21444a3451a84ca375f1e62c86cfff8c9e6.png[/img]


[b]3.　Limited Time Package Sales[/b]

　　　●Flamenco Pack (3,000JWL) (Baroque illustrated book registration available)
　　　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/32fcc70f4ce21cc6535306ef727745aafc461ff0.png[/img]
　　-　5 pieces : hair, top, bottom(skirt), skate, accessories

　　　●Westminster Pack (2,600JWL) (Baroque illustrated book registration available)
　　　　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/c166823c0a6f0fa1c07fec3c4ef29341f6bcd64b.png[/img]
　　-　4 pieces : hair, top, bottom(skirt), skate

　　　※　When you purchase of these costume sets, they can be registered in the Baroque Pictorial Book and won’t disappear after registration.


[b]4. 『Starts 「Coordination Contest」 Event[/b]
　　　 Let's show off your own unique character coordination!
　　　 A 「Coordination Contest」 icon has been added to the lobby screen.
　　 　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/e6b1b5043a5f05c23056404de52d74d06e50d64b.png[/img]

　　　[b][1]　Event Period[/b]
　　　From after maintenance on March 27, until May 21, 2025 (Wednesday) 18:00 (PDT)
　　　※Ten minutes before the event ends, we’ll start finalizing the rankings. Please keep this in mind.

　　　[b][2]　Before attending an event! Introducing New Features[/b]
　　-　1) A feature has been added to ‘My Home’ that allows you to take pictures of your characters.
　　 　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761359/ca8a3536b603232d4501798f642bf008298af836.png[/img]
　　　　＊Photography: You can take pictures of your characters.
　　　　　You can check the photos you have taken in the "Works" menu. 
　　　　　This is still before contest submission.
　　　　＊Adjust Focal Length: magnifies the character.
　　　　＊Camera Rotation: Rotates the screen slightly.
　　　　＊Adjust Aperture: Slightly blur the background of the character.
　　　　＊Action: You can pause the pause and set your favorite pose from General Actions, 
　　　　　　　　 Couple Actions, and other actions.
　　　　＊Camera Preset: Frequently used camera settings and actions can be saved as presets.
　　　　＊Hide Icon: Exclude UI from screenshot. Mouse click to unhide.
　　　　＊Works: You can check the works you have photographed.

　　　[b][3]　Let's participate in the Coordination contest![/b]
　　　　＊　Photos taken in "My Home" can be viewed in the "Works" If you receive more than 60 points from Nari, you will be able to participate in the Coordination Contest.
　　　　＊　Deletion or modification of a work submitted to the contest will only be possible after 24 hours have passed.

　　　[b][4]　Let’s vote for your favorite costume![/b]
　　　　＊　Vote ticket items can be earned by completing the weekly missions published each week.
　　　　＊　With the vote ticket you earn, you can vote for works submitted by other players.
　　　　＊　Voters can earn ‘exchange coins’ by voting, which can be exchanged for various items at the ‘Exchange Shop’.
　　　　＊　Ranks are determined by players' votes. Aim for a high rank and get many rewards!

　　　[b][5]　Collect costumes at the Collect event![/b]
　　　　＊　Costumes that can be purchased at collect events are acquired at random, but items that can be acquired once are not eliminated in duplicate.
　　　　＊　Collect all costume items tailored to the theme and get limited costumes!
　　　　　　※　Please note that the VIP discount does not apply.


[b]5.　Other[/b]
　　-　We have changed the font of the Japanese version of UI.
　　-　Modified the icon for the ‘Super Automatic Booster Card’ item.

　　-　Currently, there is a problem with the bulk mail receipt function and it is temporarily deactivated. 
　　　 We will update as soon as the problem is fixed.

[b]6. Server maintenance and checkup[/b]


The in-game UI and text might not be complete yet.
We will continue to check and fix them, so please be patient.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.
